name: Low-ATR regime momentum filter (1h)
rationale: ATR is a range-based volatility read distinct from close-to-close realized vol: a LOW ATR means tight true ranges, so a positive medium return in that regime is a clean, whipsaw-free trend worth following. Filtering momentum on low ATR avoids the wide-bar chop where trend signals decay fastest. The other side is the fader shorting a tight, grinding uptrend. Edge persists because low-true-range trends have the best follow-through per unit of stop risk. Distinct from the realized-vol momentum spec: ATR (true range incl. gaps) and vol_realized (return dispersion) capture different volatility facets. Disconfirmer: exits when the return flips negative or the stop fires.
catalyst: clean positive drift in a tight-true-range regime
